subject: Orphaned RSVPs after forwarded invite — proposing authoritative invite regeneration
body:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@granitehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Duplicate events / RSVP loop after forward

Hi Dylan,

We had the demo scheduled for Tuesday at 11am ET but one of our attendees forwarded the invite to an external contractor. Now two calendar entries showed up for some people and several attendees got duplicate reminders. A few have RSVPed to both and Google is sending update requests repeatedly — we are worried the calendar spam will confuse our execs.

I attached a screenshot of what people are seeing (looks like two events with slightly different organizers). Can you help fix this so there is a single authoritative invite?

Thanks,
Marta
Director, Partnerships
Granite Health

----
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@granitehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Duplicate events / RSVP loop after forward

Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up and for the screenshot. I can take ownership of this from our side. Quick plan: 

- Create a single authoritative invite (new .ics) and new Zoom link, cancel the stray invites, and resend as canonical from dylan_brooks@redwood.com.
- Ask you to confirm one attendee (the contractor) can be removed from the forwarded list so the old event stops generating notifications.
- Loop in our calendar ops (Ben and Laura) to do the organizer claim / cancellation steps if needed.

If that works I will regenerate now and send a cancellation for duplicates.

Best,
Dylan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Sep 15, 2025 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Dylan — give me one sec to check the event metadata. If the forwarded copy changed organizer metadata that can cause GCal to treat them as separate events. Two quick mitigations: regenerate invite + issue cancellations for the shadow events; OR if they still need the contractor invite, we can include them on the canonical invite and mark them as optional.
> 
> Laura, can you help with the cancellation and organizer claim? I can coordinate with Marta on the attendee list.
> 
> —Ben
> 
On Mon, Sep 15, 2025 at 10:08 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi team — quick ops notes based on similar incidents:
> 
> 1) Authoritative invite workflow (recommended):
>    - Cancel any events where organizer != canonical organizer (send CANCEL to those event UIDs).
>    - Create a new invite (.ics) from the canonical mailbox (dylan_brooks@redwood.com), include all attendees and set the problematic contractor as OPTIONAL.
>    - Wait 10 minutes, then send a single UPDATE from the canonical invite to everyone (this tends to converge recipient calendars).
>
> 2) If cancellation bounces (some tenants block CANCEL from non-organizer):
>    - Export the offending event UID and instruct the external organizer's calendar admin to remove the UID, or have them forward the acceptance/cancellation to the canonical organizer so we can claim.
>
> 3) Temporary mitigation: send a short email to attendees asking them to delete old event(s) and accept the new one; include the new Zoom link in the email body.
>
> I have a short script in the Drive doc that issues CANCEL/UPDATE properly (shared link below). I can run it for you if you grant me organizer rights for the event, or I can provide the steps for your IT.
>
> Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-demo-ops-guide
>
> —Laura (CS Ops)
>
On Mon, Sep 15, 2025 at 11:45 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Laura and Ben — please proceed with the authoritative invite regeneration. Laura, you can run the script from the Drive doc; Ben will coordinate with Marta on whether the contractor should remain optional or be removed.
>
> Marta — we are regenerating now. I will attach the new agenda and the regenerated .ics in the next email. Please confirm once your calendars show a single event.
>
> Attachment stubs: demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), screenshot-duplicate-events.png (image/png)
>
> —Dylan
>
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@granitehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Regenerated invite sent (canonical)

Hi all —

I ran the CANCEL/UPDATE script against the two shadow UIDs and created a new canonical invite from dylan_brooks@redwood.com. Steps I took:

- Issued CANCEL for UID x7a9 (shadow event from forwarded copy).
- Created new event UID z2k9 and sent UPDATE to full attendee list.
- Attached regenerated-invite.ics to this thread and included the fresh Zoom link in the body.

Temporary notes for recipients who still see duplicates: ask them to delete events labeled “Forwarded by” — those are the non-canonical copies. If any calendar still resends RSVP requests after 30 minutes, forward me a copy of the bounces and I will escalate to calendar admin at the recipient tenant.

Attached: regenerated-invite.ics

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@granitehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: New canonical invite + agenda (please confirm)

Marta — new invite sent from me as canonical organizer. I attached the agenda (demo-agenda.pdf) and the regenerated .ics. Link is Zoom Meeting: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode redwood123).

Please confirm once your calendar shows only one event and the reminders stop. If we see additional bounces from Google, Laura will escalate.

Thanks again for your patience — sorry for the noise.

Best,
Dylan

On Tue, Sep 16, 2025 at 17:03:00 -0700 Marta Ruiz <marta@granitehealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Dylan/Ben/Laura —
> > Confirmed — we now see a single event and reminders stopped. The contractor we mentioned was included as OPTIONAL and the forwarded copy has been deleted by the attendee who forwarded it.
> >

> >
> > Marta
